page_title: KOL 0-1 BAY | FC Koln v Bayern Munich 24/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from FC Koln comes to nothing.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
90+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) takes it short.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) plays the ball to Noussair Mazraoui with a cheeky pass and their attacking move continues.
84' The ball is cleared after Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:18.
81' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
79' CHANCE! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
78' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to send the ball in.
78' Here is a change. Luca Kilian is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
78' Florian Kainz will be replaced by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln).
77' Jan Thielmann goes off the pitch and Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) comes on.

77' Wow, what an escape. Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
74' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marvin Schwabe, who smothers the ball.
70' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
70' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
70' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

69' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
67' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
66' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
66' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) and Leon Goretzka combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
65' The substitution has been made. Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) has replaced Dejan Ljubicic.
65' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Davie Selke and he is replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
64' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) releases Jan Thielmann, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
63' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' The current number of shots on goal is 2:5.
61' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
60' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
57' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner.
55' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
55' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
55' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
54' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) and Joshua Kimmich combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
52' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
52' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Marvin Schwabe comes off his line to gather the ball.
51' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Neuer intercepts the ball.
50' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).
49' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
47' FC Koln are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Fritz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+2' The Bayern Munich players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' The resulting corner, taken by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.
43' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
43' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

42' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Marvin Schwabe, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
42' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
41' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
40' A pass by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
35' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
34' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
31' The FC Koln players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
29' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) plays a through ball but overhits it.
28' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) skips around Marvin Schwabe and has the goal at his mercy but unbelievably misses the empty net. Hold your head in shame son!
27' A crossfield pass from Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates.
26' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

22' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
18' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
16' A cross into the box from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
16' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Bayern Munich are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' FC Koln are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
12' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
10' One of the players from FC Koln times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

10' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
9' A dangerous looking corner kick from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared to safety by the defence.
9' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
7' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

6' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
5' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
5' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting, who is lurking close to the offside line.
4' The ball is cleared after Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Marco Fritz interrupts the game. One of the players from Bayern Munich won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to find Kingsley Coman, but he puts too much power on the pass.
2' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Marco Fritz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
